method: Fresh official-source retest of all 42 municipalities then present in research-backlog.json. Searches prioritized Lokale Regelgeving/Overheid.nl and current municipal legal sources, with existing detail reviews used to interpret results. A failed discovery never means no rule.
note: The original file committed on 2026-08-11 was truncated during writing and ended inside the first Alphen-Chaam record, making it invalid JSON. The incomplete fragment could not be reconstructed reliably from repository history, so no missing municipality findings have been invented here. Detailed 2026-08-11 legal-review records and later closure/retest artifacts in data/legal-review remain the authoritative evidence for those municipalities.
